description: The short loaf, before the bells

participation.context: Ate, and did not spend the Norwich sentence where nobody had asked.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Put the loaf on the board, named yesterday's fourpence, and kept the cover for the door.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Set the loaf out and did not carry the notch into the lane.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Said he would come with the house, and that if asked he is from Norwich.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.quote: If you are asked at the door, the answer is the one you already have.

story.body: You ate the short loaf. You heard that Verbeke comes because absence would be noticed, and that Norwich is the answer only if someone asks.

relations.quote: If you are asked at the door, the answer is the one you already have.

title: Ate the short loaf

participation.context: Saw the halberds and did not count them, heard the ordinance, and went home with the house.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Preached the ordinance and set the glass down after one turning.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Kept the pew together and took them out by their own door.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Came because not coming would be noticed, and left at her pace.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

participation.context: Sat in the Mayor's pew. He did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

relations.quote: I set the glass down. One turning.

story.body: You kept to the household's pew. Halberds stood at the Mayor's door, and you did not count them. You heard the ordinance, and you saw the glass set down after one turning. You left by your own door.

relations.quote: I set the glass down. One turning.

title: Heard the glass turned once at St Helen's

participation.context: Asked whether the neighbour had seen it, named yesterday's fourpence, and went up.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the bar, gave the butter and the prison their sentence, and barred the door.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Said he had heard the loom and then the knock, and sat in.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: the step, and the house kept in
relations.quote: Yesterday butter, today a prison. Mark me, they have left off asking.

story.body: You heard one telling, at the shut door. The neighbour had not seen the Poultry. Mistress Ansell barred the street door and sent the house in. You did not go out, and you did not put a number to the men.

relations.note: the step, and the house kept in
relations.quote: Yesterday butter, today a prison. Mark me, they have left off asking.

title: Heard from the step that prisoners were taken from the Counter
